craft_notes: Sthāyin: devouring-triple (swallow, slay, drink). Rows: row 2 (whom→drink). Close: drink (pivāmi as landing: the triple ends drinking). Rejected: print variant (I devour) — kept whom (edition; variant in argmap); softening frenzied — kept frenzied-formed (unmatta-tanuḥ physical).

lines: Who here, sir, shall I swallow; who here, sir, suddenly slay;
who here, sir — frenzied-formed in supreme-waking-home-devouring — shall I drink?
l4.sanskrit_cite: kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ kavalīkaromi | kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ sahasā nihanmi | kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ parabodhadhāmasañcarvaṇonmattatanuḥ pivāmi

reads_against.argmap: Whom to devour? → Triple devouring of otherness: devour, slay, drink — incorporation of all as supreme-waking-abode.
c1_essence: Devour, slay, drink — whom, here, sir — frenzied in supreme-waking-abode-devouring.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta settling (wonder worked through to rest)
